en: Color-tinted postcard showing a small round stone lookout tower with a wooden pavilion and railings on top of a hill, with a figure standing on the terrace and grassy, rocky surroundings. At the bottom edge, printed Hungarian text identifies the view and sends greetings from Pécs. The card front and margins contain handwritten cursive notes. The reverse side has the heading 'LEVELEZŐ-LAP', a green Hungarian stamp, postal cancellations from Pécs dated 1906, and an address written in pencil.
